name: The Hour Minaret
summary: A tall lantern minaret rises above a low, straight-roofed prayer hall, with a clock set directly into its shaft.
why: The crown, windowed lantern, wide balcony and tapering shaft form one continuous minaret. The clock is an actual opening in that tower, with a fitted ring and readable hands. A straight cornice defines the lower hall, and its three prayer arches share one foundation.
risk: The clock details simplify at 24 pixels. The strong tall profile remains legible as architecture, but is more civic than intimate.
sub2: Daily prayer at its appointed time
reasonToChoose: You want prayer timing built into the architecture itself.
